title: SSC MTS Full Length Mock Test 17 (Hard Level)
description: Full length mock test for SSC MTS with 90 questions covering Numerical Ability, Reasoning Ability, General Awareness and English Language. Hard level difficulty.
instructions: Total duration of the test is 90 minutes.
There is a negative marking of 1 mark for each wrong answer.
No marks will be deducted for unattempted questions.
The test consists of four sections: Numerical Ability (20), Reasoning Ability (20), General Awareness (25) and English Language (25).

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: If the price of a commodity is increased by 20% and then decreased by 15%, what is the net percentage change in the price?
questions.explanation: Let original price = 100. After 20% increase = 120. After 15% decrease = 120 × 0.85 = 102. Net increase = 2%.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 5:7. After 6 years, the ratio will become 3:4. What is the present age of A?
questions.explanation: Let present ages be 5x and 7x. Then (5x+6)/(7x+6) = 3/4. 4(5x+6) = 3(7x+6) => 20x + 24 = 21x + 18 => x = 6. A = 30 years.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 12 days and B in 18 days. They work together for 4 days, then A leaves. In how many more days will B finish the remaining work?
questions.explanation: A's 1 day = 1/12, B's = 1/18. Together 1 day = 5/36. In 4 days = 20/36 = 5/9. Remaining = 4/9. B alone = (4/9) ÷ (1/18) = 8 days.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A sum of money becomes 7/5 of itself in 4 years at simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.explanation: SI for 4 years = 2/5 of P. SI for 1 year = 2/20 = 1/10 of P. Rate = 10%.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: The average of 5 consecutive odd numbers is 25. What is the largest of these numbers?
questions.explanation: Let numbers be n-4, n-2, n, n+2, n+4. Average = n = 25. Largest = 29.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: In what ratio must water be mixed with milk costing ₹24 per litre to get a mixture worth ₹18 per litre?
questions.explanation: Using alligation: (24-18):(18-0) = 6:18 = 1:3. Water:Milk = 1:3.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: The HCF of two numbers is 12 and their LCM is 144. If one number is 36, the other is:
questions.explanation: HCF × LCM = Product. 12 × 144 = 36 × other => other = (12×144)/36 = 48.

questions.explanation: πr² = 154 => r² = 49 => r = 7. Circumference = 2πr = 44 cm.

questions.subject: Reasoning Ability
questions.question: If in a certain code, 'APPLE' is written as 'BQQMF', how is 'MANGO' written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1. M+1=N, A+1=B, N+1=O, G+1=H, O+1=P. NBOHP.

questions.subject: Reasoning Ability
questions.question: Pointing to a woman, a man said, 'She is the daughter of my father's only son.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: Father's only son = the man himself. So she is his daughter.

questions.subject: Reasoning Ability
questions.question: A man walks 5 km North, then turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right again and walks 5 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: He is 3 km East of starting point.

questions.subject: Reasoning Ability
questions.question: Statements: All cats are dogs. Some dogs are rats. Conclusions: I. Some cats are rats. II. Some rats are dogs. Which is true?
questions.explanation: Only II follows. Some rats are dogs is definite from the second statement.

questions.subject: Reasoning Ability
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, Ramesh is 15th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = Total - Left + 1 = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26th.

questions.subject: Reasoning Ability
questions.question: A is the brother of B. B is the sister of C. C is the father of D. How is A related to D?
